Portrait poster — glass greenhouse at night. Warm amber interior light glowing through panes against a cool moonlit blue exterior, soft mist and condensation on glass, lush tropical foliage (ferns, palms, orchids) as layered silhouettes and crisp foreground detail, light beams and bokeh highlights, cinematic dramatic lighting, photorealistic, shallow depth of field (50mm look), centered composition, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio, mood: serene & slightly mysterious.
